What I did

An exposed /.git/ directory let me rebuild the app’s source offline and find a UNION-based SQL injection.

The injection yielded SSH credentials. A local web shell in a cron task gave lateral movement to another user, and a sudo rule on Python 3 gave root.

Results

An open /.git/ directory allowed offline source reconstruction, which exposed the SQL injection.

Log signal: web access log: GET /.git/HEAD 200, then UNION SELECT in the query string

Next

Block dot-files at the web server, use parameterized queries and audit sudo rules on interpreters.

Withheld on purpose: credentials , flags and lab IPs .
